info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of investment portfolios by allowing users to withdraw funds from specific portfolios. It enables financial institutions or portfolio managers to efficiently handle withdrawal requests, ensuring accurate updates to both portfolio balances and transaction records. Typical consumers include financial service providers, wealth management platforms, and investment firms looking to streamline their investment operations. By using this endpoint, clients can maintain operational integrity while processing withdrawal transactions swiftly.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw funds from their portfolio. This action is essential for managing investments and liquidating assets as per user requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a withdrawal from the portfolio. Ensure that the required parameters are included to successfully process the withdrawal request.

200.description: The withdrawal request was processed successfully.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: A JSON string representing the content of the request body for the DELETE operation on portfolio withdrawal.

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the withdrawal operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: The current state of the withdrawal request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the withdrawal operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the withdrawal operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: Response structure for the DELETE operation on the portfolio withdrawal.

createdBy.description: The user who created the withdrawal request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the withdrawal request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit of the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This helps in understanding the performance of the request handling.
